headline: A 2018 executive order on the separation of families, which its title says was meant to give Congress time to act.
what_it_does: This order deals with the separation of family members, which in 2018 was tied to how the government handled families caught crossing the border. Its title says it was meant to give Congress a chance to address the issue through a new law. No official summary was provided, so the order's specific rules and directions are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order deals with whether parents and children in government custody are kept together or separated.
The order likely gave these agencies instructions on how to handle families in their custody, though the details are not provided here.
